name: Pocket Notes
summary: Offline local-first notebook with search, tag filters, safe Markdown preview, pinning, undo delete, and portable JSON/Markdown backups.

help.purpose: Capture, organize, search, and export personal notes completely offline.
help.start: Click New note, add a title, optional tags, and text, or toggle Preview to read formatted Markdown.
help.limitations: Text and Markdown only; no image uploads or cloud sync; browser-tested only, not an installed Android APK release.
help.data: All notes and skin preferences stay in browser localStorage on this device. Export JSON or Markdown for backups.
